title: Real-World Data: Ranibizumab Treatment For Retinal Vein Occlusion In The OCEAN Study

groups.description: BRVO subgroup of the RVO full analysis set of the prospective non-interventional OCEAN study (369 German sites, recruitment December 2011 to January 2015, NCT02194803): macular edema secondary to branch RVO treated with ranibizumab at the physicians' discretion and documented over 24 months; treatment-naive, anti-VEGF pre-treated and possibly pre-treated eyes (Table 1); previous corticosteroids at any time and anti-VEGF within 3 months were exclusion criteria.
CRVO subgroup of the same OCEAN RVO full analysis set (central RVO), same treatment and documentation.

series.baseline_label: Baseline BCVA (Table 2, row R4, BRVO subgroup 'Mean (SD) ETDRS letters' column C5)
series.notes: Mean (SD) ETDRS letters (Table 2 header). Observed cases (Methods: analyses used an observed cases approach; LOCF only for the separate 'last visit'). n is the number of BRVO eyes with a baseline BCVA (Table 2 R4C4) of the 204 in the subgroup; per-visit numbers fall over time (Table 2 column C4) with considerable loss to follow-up. Follow-up visits were sorted into a predefined schedule of 30-day intervals (+/- 15 days); the month labels are used. Time origin: first ranibizumab injection of the study.

series.baseline_label: Baseline BCVA (Table 2, row R4, CRVO subgroup 'Mean (SD) ETDRS letters' column C7)
series.notes: Mean (SD) ETDRS letters (Table 2 header). Observed cases (Methods: analyses used an observed cases approach; LOCF only for the separate 'last visit'). n is the number of CRVO eyes with a baseline BCVA (Table 2 R4C6) of the 121 in the subgroup; per-visit numbers fall over time (Table 2 column C6) with considerable loss to follow-up. Follow-up visits were sorted into a predefined schedule of 30-day intervals (+/- 15 days); the month labels are used. Time origin: first ranibizumab injection of the study.

notes: Unit: ETDRS letters (Table 2 header; BCVA documented by the physicians in ETDRS letters).
Groups are subgroups defined at baseline by the type of occlusion (control); treatment and examinations at the physicians' discretion in routine care with an approved agent, no experimental arm.

Regimen unstated: treatment and prescription were at the physicians' discretion; the article cites a national recommendation of at least three monthly injections followed by PRN or treat-and-extend, and reports injections at baseline in all patients and at months 1 and 2 in most.
Prior treatment mixed: treatment-naive, anti-VEGF pre-treated and possibly pre-treated eyes in both subgroups (Table 1).
Vitrectomy in two patients was reported among adverse events; values were not stated as removed.
Central retinal thickness, OCT counts and injection counts are reported in the article and mentioned here only.
